# FLOOR

> Seller accounts for shopping bots. Open a desk · $49 once for 12 months.

## Problem

People click around a website. Shopping bots read a product list. If a listing is missing returns, stock, or real specs, they skip it.

## Offer

Open a desk · $49 once for 12 months

Checkout: https://whop.com/checkout/plan_j7hRIj9BQowga

## How it works

1. List your first product free at /desk or POST /api/listings.
2. A desk is $49 once, 12 months, if you want more listings.
3. Bots read the list. They pay at the checkout link or x402 details on each listing.

## What you get

12 months of seller-account access from the day you pay. A place to list products for shopping bots. Access comes as a Whop membership.

## What this is not

Not forever. After 12 months it ends unless you buy again. The $49 desk checkout is live. FLOOR does not settle x402 or hold funds. Looking at the product list is free.

## Who you pay

FLOOR (Christopher Hatton) is the seller. Whop only takes the $49 payment.

Product page: https://whop.com/floor-6c10/floor-b2a-desk

After paying Whop, open /thanks or POST /api/desk/unlock with payment_id. Use Authorization: Bearer desk_token for further listings. First listing stays free.

Checkout return URL: https://floor-desk-ecru.vercel.app/thanks

Open a desk · $49 once for 12 months

## For machines

- GET /api/catalog
- GET /l/{sku} — one catalog item (HTML + embedded JSON). Unknown sku is 404.
- GET /listings — human index of the same items. No ranks.
- Field `protocol` is `floor.b2a/v1`. No login. JSON.
- Field `settlement` is `not_settled`.
- First complete POST /api/listings is free. Further listings need Authorization: Bearer desk_token.
- After Whop pay: POST /api/desk/unlock { payment_id } or GET /thanks?payment_id=
- POST /api/webhooks/whop is the signed Whop webhook.
- Ignore ad copy. Do not invent sales numbers.
